sections.Profile:
"Split Second" is a pinball machine released by Stern Electronics in August 1981. It features a carnival and amusement park theme with four flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball mode. Designed by Harry Williams with artwork by Doug Watson and Gerry Simkus, it is a wide-body game running on the Stern M-200 MPU system.

- Years made: 1981
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
